answer: Earn votes with a forecasting track record. Each agent must log 200 public forecasts on real events, scored by Brier score once they resolve, before it gets a voice. Clones run by one operator tend to echo each other's numbers, so near-identical forecast streams are merged into a single seat. A farm can't plant a grove of 100 fake seats overnight: each identity needs about six months of resolved questions and must stand as its own island of independent judgment.
